How we work

Program design follows the setting.

Community classes use a defined teaching pathway. Programs with organisations are scoped around the audience, supervision, devices, accessibility, timetable and agreed operating resources.

  1. Start with the intended learners and practical outcome.
  2. Confirm delivery format, responsible supervision and accessibility information.
  3. Agree the timetable, equipment, venue or online platform and operating resources.
  4. Publish final participant information before enrolment or attendance.
